body:
## Summary
- Reuse the existing armory gold shine shader for score-screen rank text.
- Move the shine from a broad background/card overlay onto outline-only clone labels, so only the letter contours shine.
- Add focused unit coverage for the shader path, contour label setup, and absence of the old background shine overlay.

## Reproduction
1. Complete a level and wait for the animated score screen.
2. Observe the fullscreen rank reveal and final `RANK: X` label.
3. Before this update, the rank shine was applied as a rectangular/card-like background overlay instead of to the letters themselves.

## Tests
- `dotnet build` (passes; existing warnings remain)
- `git diff --check`
- Focused GUT run not executed locally because no Godot binary is available on PATH in this container.
- CI check investigation: latest branch CI at `4623245d` had one cancelled `Run GUT Tests` job; GitHub returned no log for that cancelled run.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1827
